Data extraction: nginx config directives as KeyValue nodes

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"data_extraction\":true,\"language\":\"nginx\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "worker_processes 4;\nerror_log /var/log/nginx/error.log;\n", config: configObj)
debugPrint(result.data() as Any)
debugPrint(result.data()?.kind() as Any)
```
